description: Normalize a MAC-48 or EUI-64. Accepts colon, hyphen, Cisco dotted (groups of four) or plain hex, any case. Returns lowercase colon, hyphen, dotted and compact forms. multicast is the I/G bit, the low bit of the first octet. local is the U/L bit, the next bit. oui is the first three octets as hex, not a vendor name. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/mac-address
name: mac_address
title: Mac Address
